Dear MultipleChat team,

I'm applying for the Professional Content Creator role. Your focus on AI tools, productivity, and digital workflows is exactly where I work every day: I use Claude and ChatGPT for research and content, write SEO articles that rank, and build websites that are easy to find in both traditional and AI-powered search.

I also create scripts and short-form content, and I'm comfortable with Canva and video editing tools.

I'd love to help MultipleChat simplify complex AI topics into clear, engaging content. My CV is attached, and I'm happy to discuss how I can contribute.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear MultipleChat team,

I'm writing to apply for the Professional Content Creator role. Your mission to make AI tools and digital workflows accessible matches how I already work: I use Claude and ChatGPT daily for research, content creation, and audits, and I write SEO-optimized articles that help people understand technical topics without the jargon.

At Episto, I handle on-page SEO and content for client websites, from keyword research to publishing in WordPress. I've written keyword-targeted blog content for consultancy and e-commerce clients, and I manage content for a pharmacists' association site with around 600 member profiles. Freelance, I built and optimized mirook.com, implementing structured data and an llms.txt file, and ran technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised its search-health score. That hands-on experience taught me how to simplify complex subjects—like AI search visibility—into clear, useful content.

I also create scripts for short videos and educational content, and I'm comfortable with Canva and video editing tools. My background in front-end development and automation (Python, JavaScript, an Android app on Google Play) means I can collaborate smoothly with marketing and product teams on content strategy and research trends in AI and SaaS.

I'd welcome the chance to bring my mix of content, SEO, and AI fluency to MultipleChat and help your audience get more out of AI tools. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
